clips.text: Reading is hard work for a lot of people. So this website changes to suit you. Look for Make it comfy, at the top of every page.
You can make the letters bigger, or give them more room. And there are letters made for dyslexia, too.
You can change the colour of the paper. Cream, a soft tint, or dark, if a bright page dazzles you.
There is a ruler to keep your place. It follows your pointer, or your finger, and dims everything else.
And you can have any words on the site read out. Just press them. That voice is not me, mind. It is your own device's.
Whatever you choose is remembered on your own device, and nowhere else. Go on. Get comfy.
